title: Michal’s Marriage and Saul’s Snare
reflectionText: Saul’s servants carry words of favor to David, while Saul intends the marriage to become a snare. Michal’s love remains, and Saul’s fear grows. What is it like to enter a household where one person loves you and another keeps seeking your fall?
